name: 32666 · Melrose, FL
findings: ZIP 32666 (Melrose) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32666 (Melrose) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32666 (Melrose) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
